app.name: RecordMii
app.short_description: Record the Wii Speak to WAV
app.long_description:
Records audio from a Wii Speak to 16-bit mono WAV files in sd:/wiispeak.
Requires pmic_firm.bin (the Wii Speak's boot firmware, extracted from an RVL SDK pmic.a) alongside this app. Rate, mic gain and the echo canceller are adjustable.
A: start/stop recording. LEFT/RIGHT: sample rate. UP/DOWN: gain. B: echo canceller. HOME: exit.
